question.text: What percentage of companies globally will fulfill their pre-2026 cage-free commitments in 2026 and 2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the percentage of global companies reporting in 2026 or 2027 that they have fulfilled the cage-free commitments they made before 2026 according to [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker) when accessed by Metaculus on January 1, 2028.
question.fine_print:
Specifically, the denominator will be obtained by selecting the "Cage-Free" issue on the [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free) progress tracker, a "Victory Date" of 1990 to 2025, and a "Timeline" of 2026 and after. The numerator will then be obtained by *additionally* selecting the "Reporting Fulfilled" status.

If Chicken Watch ceases reporting or significantly changes its criteria such that previous reporting is not comparable, this question will be **annulled**.

research:
I couldn't get the number this question resolves on. The Chicken Watch progress tracker loads its data with JavaScript, and every fetch came back with no counts, filters or statuses. A guessed data address (/api/commitments) returned a 404. I found no published current figure for cage-free commitments made before 2026 with a deadline of 2026 or later that show "Reporting Fulfilled". To get it, open the tracker in a normal browser and set the filters as the fine print describes.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-12: The tracker page shows only navigation and the "© Chicken Watch 2026" footer as text, with no counts. The /cage-free page says only "over 1,000 companies" have pledged to remove cages from their egg supply chains. [Chicken Watch tracker](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free), [Chicken Watch cage-free](https://chickenwatch.org/cage-free)
- Note: the numerator counts any commitment due 2026 or later that is already marked "Reporting Fulfilled", including ones fulfilled before 2026. It is a running total that only grows as companies report, and the denominator is fixed to commitments made from 1990 to 2025. The question's range of 3.56% to 30.19% suggests the question writer saw a low starting value, but I could not confirm that.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The value can still change until Metaculus checks the tracker on 2028-01-01.
- Some companies with 2026 deadlines have fulfilled early. Caffè Nero met its goal ahead of its 2026 deadline (Fair and Fowl 2026). Chick-fil-A has said its 2026 cage-free commitment is in doubt, citing bird flu. [EIN Presswire](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/944933228/fair-and-fowl-2026-finds-cage-free-sourcing-is-now-standard-practice-as-corporate-holdouts-dwindle), [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/food-drink/chick-fil-a-retreats-decade-old-egg-pledge-bird-flu-hits-supply)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-10: The Humane League's 2026 Eggsposé covers about 100 US restaurant and convenience chains. Subway, McDonald's, Starbucks and Dairy Queen are fulfilled, but there is still a "significant accountability gap". The report projects that half of US hens will be cage-free by 2027. [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/new-report-reveals-major-cage-free-progress-across-us-restaurant-chains-but-some-big-brands-still-fall-short-302933673.html)
- 2026-09-29: The Open Wing Alliance's Fair and Fowl 2026 report found 118 of 171 global companies (about 69%) fulfilled or making progress. More than 2,800 companies worldwide have made cage-free pledges, and 2025 was the biggest deadline year. [EIN Presswire](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/944933228/fair-and-fowl-2026-finds-cage-free-sourcing-is-now-standard-practice-as-corporate-holdouts-dwindle)
- 2026 (undated): Compassion in World Farming's EggTrack puts the average cage-free transition at 85% (75% in 2023), and 50 businesses have withdrawn their pledges. BBFAW 2026 found 96 companies with cage-free targets, of which only 17 (18%) report 100% cage-free eggs. [The Grocer](https://www.thegrocer.co.uk/news/global-cage-free-egg-transition-is-gaining-pace-compassion-in-world-farming-says/721037.article), [Food and Drink Technology](https://www.foodanddrinktechnology.com/news/66693/bbfaw-global-food-falling-short-on-higher-welfare-commitments/)
- 2026-03-06: Lagardère Travel Retail reported global 100% cage-free fulfillment, using egg credits. [DFNI](https://www.dfnionline.com/latest-news/retail/open-wing-alliance-welcomes-lagardere-travel-retails-global-100-cage-free-egg-sourcing-06-03-2026/)
- 2026-01-13: The OWA's "Rotten Eggs" release named global restaurant chains that missed their 2025 deadlines. [EIN Presswire](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/882544308/the-open-wing-alliance-names-global-restaurant-giants-for-missing-cage-free-deadlines)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-02-02 (Chicken Watch data, cited by Faunalytics):
  - 64% of global cage-free commitments due in 2025 or earlier were fulfilled, against 93% of those due in 2024.
  - By region: Europe 70%, Africa 62%, Asia 58%, Latin America 50%.
  - The chart covering commitments due 2026 and later is only an image, so I could not read it.
  - [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- Earlier headline fulfillment rates for commitments already due:
  - 2024-05: 89%. [Food Industry Executive](https://foodindustryexecutive.com/2024/05/new-data-shows-89-of-cage-free-egg-commitments-are-fulfilled-by-food-corporations/)
  - Later: 92%. [Food Processing](https://www.foodprocessing.com/ingredients/dairy-cheese-eggs/news/55307812/92-of-global-cage-free-egg-commitments-fulfilled)
- What this implies: companies that report fulfillment early, before their deadline year, are a much smaller group than those reporting once a deadline has passed. A rate in single digits or the teens fits the question's range, but I could not confirm it.
- Seasonality: none in the usual sense. Updates tend to cluster around reporting cycles: corporate sustainability reports (mostly Q1 to Q2), the OWA Fair and Fowl report (around September), the Eggsposé (around November) and the Rotten Eggs release (around January). I found no year-by-year history of this exact filter.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Metaculus community forecast, Polymarket market or Manifold market for this question.
- Kalshi prices 73% Yes that Cal-Maine will say "Cage-Free" on its 2027-01-06 earnings call. That is related but tells you almost nothing about this question.
- Related Metaculus question: the forecast date for 5,000 companies having pledged to go cage-free is around 2033 to 2034. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/3381/date-of-5000-egg-companies-cage-free)
- The question appears to come from proposals for an animal-focused Metaculus tournament. [Forum post](https://forum.nunosempere.com/posts/pxYdSh3hjSCEMk68z/call-for-questions-on-animal-focused-forecasting-tournament)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- January 2027: the 2027 "Rotten Eggs" release is likely, along with year-end updates for commitments due in 2026.
- 2027-01-06: Cal-Maine earnings call, a signal for US cage-free supply.
- Q1 to Q2 2027: corporate sustainability and ESG reports, the main way new "Reporting Fulfilled" statuses get added.
- Around September 2027: OWA Fair and Fowl 2027. Around November 2027: Eggsposé 2027. Also the 2027 EggTrack and BBFAW reports.
- Ongoing risks:
  - Bird flu outbreaks driving up costs (Chick-fil-A precedent).
  - Companies withdrawing pledges, which could shrink the denominator.
  - Chicken Watch changing its methodology or filters, which would annul the question.
  - Lags in how fast Chicken Watch logs new reports.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 13.5 months until Metaculus reads the tracker on 2028-01-01. Forecasts close 2027-06-30.

(b) I have no confirmed current reading. The question bounds work out to exact fractions of 323: 12/323 = 3.715% and 97/323 = 30.03%. That suggests that when the question was written, about 12 of roughly 323 commitments made before 2026 with deadlines of 2026 or later showed "Reporting Fulfilled", about 3.7%. The writing date is probably 2025 or early 2026. The research assistant could not load the live tracker.

(c) If nothing changed, the result would be about 4 to 6%, allowing for some early fulfillments already logged during 2026 (Caffè Nero, Lagardère and others).

(d) If the current trend continued, the value would rise as follows:
- Chicken Watch seems to update quickly after each deadline year. Faunalytics published 2025-deadline fulfillment (64%) in February 2026.
- The early-2027 update should therefore assess the 2026-deadline cohort, which is likely a large share (perhaps 30 to 45%) of the denominator.
- If about 50% of that cohort reports fulfillment, plus 5 to 10% early fulfillment among the 2027 to 2030 deadlines, the total is roughly 15 to 25%.
- Lags in reporting and in Chicken Watch logging reports pull this down somewhat.

(e) Historically the numerator grows in steps at annual tracker updates. A move from about 4% to the mid-teens over two years is plausible. Fulfillment rates for already-due cohorts have ranged from 64% to 93%.

(f) I found no market or community forecast. The question creator's upper guide of about 30% implies they expect meaningful growth. Fair and Fowl 2026 found about 69% of global companies fulfilled or making progress. BBFAW found only 18% of companies with cage-free targets reporting 100% cage-free.

(g) Scenarios:
- Low: Chicken Watch delays its update until after January 2028, or bird flu leads to withdrawals and missed deadlines. The value stays at about 5%.
- High: a large 2026 cohort reports en masse, egg credits are counted, and withdrawn pledges shrink the denominator. The value exceeds 35%.
